notes.title: Hero of the Kingdom v1.52 patch
notes.notes:
v1.52 changes:
-Windows executable is now 64-bit by default. A separate 32-bit executable is provided for a backward compatibility.
-Fixed a small visual glitch on low resolution displays.
-macOS application bundle rearranged to the regular format
-macOS system requirement increased from 10.6 to 10.8

notes.title: Game update
notes.notes:
The primary concern of this update is to support Windows 8 tablet PC. The secondary concern is to add in-game user profiles as requested by players.

Changes:
[list]
[*]Added native support for touch control. It was only emulated before and it did not ensure intended experience in all cases.
[*]Full screen mode now works as borderless window covering entire screen instead of true full screen mode. It is more compatible with screen orientation changes and multi-monitor setups. It also allows to activate Windows 8 charms bar while playing full screen (especially useful on tablets).
[*]Added in-game user profiles. The feature can be activated in SETTINGS menu. Each user profile has its own game progress and achievements.
[*]Many optimizations and less important fixes. 
[/list]
